optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Owns the reporting-engine migration end-to-end, holding the go-live decision for each adviser cohort.
professionalSummary.witness: Reference call with the former programme director: said the candidate 'carried the project day to day' and 'I would happily have let him take the go-live calls'; confirmed employment dates.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the project plan, the risk log and the cohort schedule in the project tool.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the project plan, the risk log and the adviser-cohort schedule for the reporting-engine migration in the project tool, re-planning the schedule when the data-migration phase slipped by three weeks.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Prepares and presents the steering committee update and records decisions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Prepared the steering committee pack each month and presented the schedule and risk sections; the programme director chaired the committee and put the cohort go-live decisions to it.

skills.text: Coordinates cohort readiness with adviser operations and the platform team and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and the platform team through the readiness checklist; each cohort's go-live was approved by the steering committee on the programme director's recommendation.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's ownership of the migration project, maintenance of the project plan, risk log, and cohort schedule, preparation of steering committee updates, and coordination of cohort readiness. They do not establish the candidate's budget ownership or the specific go-live decisions made.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and evidence are documented, but further human review is required to determine suitability for the role.
